creation_statements: CREATE ROLE "{{name}}" WITH LOGIN INHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 20 PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT securegate_iam_runtime TO "{{name}}";
revocation_statements: DO $revoke$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='{{name}}') THEN ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" NOLOGIN; PERFORM pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename='{{name}}' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid(); DROP ROLE "{{name}}"; END IF; END $revoke$;
